items.title: Building Hope: PulteGroup Delivers 100th Mortgage-Free Home to a U.S. Veteran

items.title: PulteGroup Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.22 Per Share
items.summary: PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.22 per common share payable October 2, 2025, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 16, 2025.

items.title: PulteGroup Promotes Scott Bryson to Dallas Division President
items.summary: PulteGroup (NYSE: PHM), today announced the promotion of Scott Bryson to president of its Dallas division. With nearly 20 years of experience with the Company, Bryson will lead all aspects of the division's homebuilding operations.
